release_notes: First stable release of flake8-lint: a standalone, reusable AST-based Python lint rule engine.
Ships four ways to run the same core: standalone CLI (flake8-lint check), Python API, a thin Flake8 plugin adapter, and an opt-in pytest helper (assert_lint_clean).

Built-in rules X001-X012 (X003 reserved/disabled), covering bare excepts, overly broad exceptions, muted exceptions, docstring requirements, local imports, missing/None return annotations, percent-formatting, import-error suppression, Optional usage, and union-type annotations.
Custom rule support via project-local rule modules and installed flake8_lint.rules entry points, with duplicate/invalid-code detection at registry resolution time.
Config discovery precedence: --config PATH > flake8_lint.toml > pyproject.toml [tool.flake8_lint] > legacy [tool.flake8_lint_tests] > defaults.
Engine-owned # noqa suppression semantics shared across all four integration surfaces.
CI verified on Python 3.11 through 3.14, including a wheel-smoke job exercising the built package end-to-end.
